I downloaded and inspected the v3.17.0 zip directly. `mavsdk_export.h` **is present**:

```
include/mavsdk/mavsdk_export.h   ← present
```

`MAVSDKConfig.cmake` sets `INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES` to both `${MAVSDK_ROOT_DIR}/include` and `${MAVSDK_ROOT_DIR}/include/mavsdk`, so the file is reachable as either `#include <mavsdk/mavsdk_export.h>` or `#include <mavsdk_export.h>`. No shipped header references a `.hpp` extension — the `.hpp` rename was only on `main` and was never backported to v3.

Could you clarify what exact error you're seeing? Are you getting a compiler error like `cannot open include file: 'mavsdk/mavsdk_export.h'`, or something else? It's possible the zip download was incomplete/corrupted — re-downloading and re-extracting might help.

One unrelated cmake oddity I noticed: `MAVSDKTargets.cmake` has `${_IMPORT_PREFIX}/include/mavsdk` repeated ~38 times in `INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES` (one entry per target, all duplicated). This is harmless since the Windows dual-config code in `MAVSDKConfig.cmake` builds the target manually and overrides it anyway, but it's worth cleaning up.

[mavsdk-windows-x64.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/26742795/mavsdk-windows-x64.zip)This is the zip package I downloaded. Later, I searched for a .h file in the source code and put it in.

Thanks for sharing the zip — that makes it clear. I downloaded your uploaded zip and compared it against the official [v3.17.0 `mavsdk-windows-x64.zip`](https://github.com/mavlink/MAVSDK/releases/download/v3.17.0/mavsdk-windows-x64.zip) from the Releases page:

| | Official v3.17.0 | Your zip |
|---|---|---|
| `include/mavsdk/mavsdk_export.h` | ✅ present | ❌ missing |
| All other files | identical | identical |

The official release zip does contain `mavsdk_export.h`. Your zip is missing exactly that one file, which suggests you may have downloaded from a mirror, a build artifact, or an older/interim release rather than directly from the GitHub Releases page.

**Fix**: Download the zip fresh from the official Releases page:  
https://github.com/mavlink/MAVSDK/releases/download/v3.17.0/mavsdk-windows-x64.zip

Re-extracting that should give you `include/mavsdk/mavsdk_export.h` and resolve the build error.

```
include/mavsdk/mavsdk_export.h   ✅ present
```

The release asset itself is intact. The first S3 URL in your comment (`objects.githubusercontent.com/github-production-repository-file-5c1aeb/94815442/26742795`) is actually the file *you uploaded* to this issue thread — it's a GitHub user attachment, not the official release download. That's likely the source of the discrepancy.

The second URL (`release-assets.githubusercontent.com/…`) is a correct signed release asset URL, but those temporary links expire after a few minutes, so re-downloading via that URL after it expires can fail silently.

**Recommended steps:**

1. Download fresh using the stable permalink: https://github.com/mavlink/MAVSDK/releases/download/v3.17.0/mavsdk-windows-x64.zip
2. After extracting, verify `include/mavsdk/mavsdk_export.h` is present
3. If still missing, try: `gh release download v3.17.0 --repo mavlink/MAVSDK --pattern mavsdk-windows-x64.zip`

If the issue persists after a fresh download from the permalink, please share the SHA256 checksum of your zip (`certutil -hashfile mavsdk-windows-x64.zip SHA256` on Windows) so we can compare.
